items.title: Micah Parsons: Questionable, but should debut Wednesday
items.text:
Parsons (knee) is officially listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

items.text:

items.title: Kenneth Walker: Returning to practice Tuesday
items.text:
Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said that Walker (groin) will practice Tuesday, Nate Taylor of ESPN.com reports. "I'm not anticipating a ton of work," Reid said. "Let's see how does. He's feeling pretty good."

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sam Darnold: Still tracking toward Week 12 start
items.text:
Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Darnold (quadriceps/rib) made a "good bit of progress" over the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and will start Sunday at San Francisco if he fares well during Wednesday's practice, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.
